# Day2Day API — LLM Integration Guide

> Personal college schedule & assignment REST API.
> Base URL: `https://day2day.darrxd.my.id`
> Default Timezone: `Asia/Makassar` (WITA, UTC+8)
> Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>` (prefix `d2d_live_...`, or browser session cookie)
> Content-Type: `application/json` (for `POST`/`PATCH`)

## Agent Rules

1. Always use `Asia/Makassar` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, 24h `HH:mm`) unless overridden by `timezone`.
2. Check `GET /api/schedules/free-time?date=YYYY-MM-DD` before calling `POST /api/schedules`.
3. On `409 SCHEDULE_CONFLICT`, read the conflicting window in `error.message` and pick another free slot.
4. Classify `category` via the Eisenhower Matrix:
   - `IMPORTANT_URGENT` (Q1: exams, urgent deadlines)
   - `IMPORTANT_NOT_URGENT` (Q2: deep study, future tasks, exercise)
   - `NOT_IMPORTANT_URGENT` (Q3: quick tasks, errands)
   - `NOT_IMPORTANT_NOT_URGENT` (Q4: leisure)

## Enums (Strict Literals)

- `category`: `IMPORTANT_URGENT` | `IMPORTANT_NOT_URGENT` | `NOT_IMPORTANT_URGENT` | `NOT_IMPORTANT_NOT_URGENT`
- `repeat.type`: `none` | `daily` | `weekly` | `monthly` | `yearly` | `custom`
- `repeat.days[]`: `SUNDAY` | `MONDAY` | `TUESDAY` | `WEDNESDAY` | `THURSDAY` | `FRIDAY` | `SATURDAY`
- `status` (assignment): `PENDING` | `IN_PROGRESS` | `COMPLETED`
- `view` (assignment query): `active` | `overdue` | `completed` | `all`

## Error Format

`{"success": false, "error": {"code": string, "message": string, "details"?: any}}`
- `400 BAD_REQUEST` (malformed JSON / missing param)
- `401 UNAUTHORIZED`
- `404 NOT_FOUND`
- `409 SCHEDULE_CONFLICT` (overlap detected; recurring checks up to 90 days)
- `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` (Zod field errors in `details`)

---

## Schedules (`/api/schedules`)

### Endpoints
- `GET /api/schedules/today?timezone=` -> `{date, timezone, activities: Occurrence[]}`
- `GET /api/schedules?date=YYYY-MM-DD&timezone=` -> `{date, timezone, activities: Occurrence[]}` (`date` defaults to today)
- `GET /api/schedules?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD&timezone=` -> `{from, to, timezone, results: [{date, occurrences: Occurrence[]}]}`
- `GET /api/schedules/free-time?date=YYYY-MM-DD&timezone=` -> `{date, free_time: [{start, end, duration_minutes}]}` (24h `00:00`–`24:00`)
- `GET /api/schedules/summary?date=YYYY-MM-DD&timezone=` -> `{date, total_minutes, scheduled_minutes, free_minutes, scheduled_percentage, free_percentage, activity_count}`
- `POST /api/schedules` -> `201` `ScheduleItem` (runs conflict detection)
- `PATCH /api/schedules/:id` -> `200` `ScheduleItem` (partial body; runs conflict detection)
- `DELETE /api/schedules/:id` -> `200` `{success: true, message}`

`Occurrence`: `{id, title, category, start, end, duration_minutes, repeat_type}` (`date` & `timezone` also included in range results).
`ScheduleItem`: `{id, user_id, title, category, start_date, start_time, end_time, repeat_type, repeat_config, timezone, created_at, updated_at}`.

### `POST /api/schedules` Body
- Required: `title` (1..255), `category`, `date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`), `start` (`HH:mm`), `end` (`HH:mm`, strictly `> start`)
- Optional: `timezone` (default `"Asia/Makassar"`), `repeat` (default `{"type":"none"}`):
  `{type, interval?: int>=1 (default 1), days?: DayOfWeek[], until?: "YYYY-MM-DD"|null}`
- `PATCH` note: send both `start` and `end` together if updating times to guarantee `end > start` validation.

Example (recurring weekly):
```json
{"title":"Kuliah Struktur Data","category":"IMPORTANT_URGENT","date":"2026-09-28","start":"08:00","end":"10:30","repeat":{"type":"weekly","interval":1,"days":["MONDAY","WEDNESDAY"],"until":"2026-12-31"}}
```

---

## Assignments (`/api/assignments`)

### Endpoints
- `GET /api/assignments?view=active&course=` -> `{view, summary: {total, active, overdue, completed}, count, assignments: AssignmentItem[]}`
  - `view` defaults to `active`; `course` filters `course_name` (case-insensitive exact match).
- `POST /api/assignments` -> `201` `AssignmentItem`
- `PATCH /api/assignments/:id` -> `200` `AssignmentItem`
- `DELETE /api/assignments/:id` -> `200` `{success: true, message}`

`AssignmentItem`: `{id, user_id, title, course_name, due_date, due_time, estimated_duration_minutes, category, status, notes, completed_at, created_at, updated_at, is_overdue, days_remaining}`.

### `POST /api/assignments` Body
- Required: `title` (1..255), `due_date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`), `category`
- Optional: `course_name` (<=100 | null), `due_time` (`HH:mm`, default `"23:59"`), `estimated_duration_minutes` (int `5..1440`, default `120`), `status` (default `"PENDING"`), `notes` (<=2000 | null)
- `PATCH` behavior: accepts any field above + `completed_at` (string | null). Setting `status: "COMPLETED"` auto-sets `completed_at`; non-completed statuses reset it to `null`.

Example:
```json
{"title":"Makalah Etika Profesi","course_name":"Etika Profesi","due_date":"2026-10-02","due_time":"23:59","estimated_duration_minutes":120,"category":"IMPORTANT_NOT_URGENT","notes":"APA 7th, min 5 pages"}
```

---

## API Keys & Docs

- `GET /api/keys` -> `{keys: [{id, user_id, name, key_prefix, last_used_at, created_at, revoked_at}]}`
- `POST /api/keys` -> body `{name?}` -> `201` `{message, key, apiKey}` (plaintext `key` returned once)
- `DELETE /api/keys/:id` -> revokes key -> `200` `{success: true, message}`
- `GET /api/docs` (HTML) | `GET /api/docs?format=json` | `GET /api/openapi.json` (OpenAPI 3.1 JSON)

---

## Standard Auto-Scheduling Flow

1. `GET /api/assignments?view=active` -> select target task, read `due_date` & `estimated_duration_minutes`.
2. `GET /api/schedules/free-time?date=YYYY-MM-DD` -> pick slot where `duration_minutes >= estimated_duration_minutes`.
3. `POST /api/schedules` -> book work session (retry another slot if `409`).
4. `PATCH /api/assignments/:id` -> `{"status":"IN_PROGRESS"}` or `{"status":"COMPLETED"}`.
